summary: This Qantas web page explains the Fly Carbon Neutral program, through which customers can offset the emissions of their flights by tick-box at booking. Contributions fund accredited offset projects worldwide with a focus on Australian Indigenous and regional communities, and Qantas states it does not profit from the program. The page also describes the projects funded (rainforest protection, Indigenous fire management, Indian wind farms) and the Qantas Points and Green Tier rewards for offsetting.
one_line: Qantas page describing its Fly Carbon Neutral program, which lets passengers offset flight emissions funding projects, with Qantas Points rewards.
key_facts: Qantas states that Fly Carbon Neutral calculates emissions for each route it flies, and customers can 'tick-the-box' to offset their share when booking.
Qantas states that it does not profit from Fly Carbon Neutral and that every dollar is directly funding carbon offsetting.
Offset projects are purchased from accredited, premium projects worldwide, with a focus on Australian projects supporting Indigenous and regional communities.

Carbon offset projects are subject to scrutiny from global accredited registries, the Australian Government's Clean Energy Regulator, and the principles of the Australian Government's Climate Active Carbon program.
Qantas will match every dollar customers spend on Fly Carbon Neutral, for double the impact.
Qantas members earn 10 Qantas Points for every A$1 spent on offsetting flights booked at qantas.com.
Choosing to Fly Carbon Neutral can cost from as little as $2 for a Sydney to Melbourne flight.
For residents of Australia, choosing to Fly Carbon Neutral counts towards achieving Green Tier status.
The Rainforest rescue project protects large hectares of native forest in South America, Oceania and Africa that are under threat of deforestation and degradation.
The Fighting fire with fire project in Northern Australia supports Indigenous rangers who use traditional fire management practices to conduct early season dry burns.
The Winds of change project funds wind farms across India that replace electricity which would otherwise be generated by coal-fired power stations.
Qantas Freight retail customers can offset emissions on all Australian domestic freight bookings.
To be recognised for Green Tier, offsets made from 26 November 2021 count towards Green Tier, recognised seven days after purchase.
Qantas Points offsetting rewards are only awarded with Fly Carbon Neutral when the customer pays with cash.
